newsitem.title: USA: ICF Kaiser part of $100 mln FEMA contract.
newsitem.headline: ICF Kaiser part of $100 mln FEMA contract.

text.p: ICF Kaiser International Inc said Monday it is part of a joint venture that has been awarded a $100 million contract to provide program management support and technical engineering assistance to the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA).
The joint venture, with the engineering firm of Daniel Mann Johnson & Mendenhall, is called Emergency Response Program Management Support.
ICF Kaiser issued a statement saying the base contract is for one year, with four additional one-year options.
ICF spokeswoman Denise Piastrelli said "we're not disclosing" the value of the contract to ICF.
